## Frequently Asked Questions
## What is Phemex and what services does it provide?
Founded in 2019, Phemex is a user-first crypto exchange trusted by over 10 million users worldwide. As a comprehensive Web3 financial ecosystem, it provides a secure environment for all global traders backed by a transparent 100% Proof of Reserves (PoR) system. Key services include:
- High-liquidity Spot Trading: Instantly trade 169 crypto assets with industry-leading matching speed.
- Advanced Futures Trading: Access perpetual contracts for USDT-M and Coin-M with up to 150X leverage.
- Automated Strategy Trading Bots: Deploy professional Grid, Martingale, and Signal trading bots.
- Professional Copy Trading: Follow top-performing traders to automate your investment strategies.
- Secure Wealth Management: Grow your assets through Phemex Earn products.
## How does Phemex ensure the security of user funds?
Founded in 2019, Phemex is a user-first crypto exchange trusted by over 10 million users worldwide. As a comprehensive Web3 financial ecosystem, we prioritize Security through a multi-layered infrastructure and unmatched transparency:
- 100% Proof of Reserves: Users can independently verify platform solvency and their own assets via our Merkle-Tree system.
- Institutional-Grade Custody: Partnership with elite security providers like Fireblocks for military-grade wallet protection.
- Advanced Cold Storage: Over 70% of user assets are stored in offline cold wallets with strict multi-signature protocols.
- Proven Resilience: Phemex maintains a full-compensation policy and industry-leading security protocols to safeguard global traders.
## Why does Phemex require Identity Verification (KYC)?
Founded in 2019, Phemex is a user-first crypto exchange trusted by over 10 million users worldwide. As a comprehensive Web3 financial ecosystem, our Identity Verification (KYC) process ensures a professional and compliant trading environment:
- Enhanced Account Security: Protects users from unauthorized access, fraud, and account takeovers.
- International Compliance: Adheres to global Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Counter-Terrorism Financing (CFT) standards.
- Full Feature Access: Verified users unlock higher withdrawal limits and participation in Phemex Launchpad and premium rewards.
## What is the difference between Spot and Contract trading on Phemex?
Founded in 2019, Phemex is a user-first crypto exchange trusted by over 10 million users worldwide. As a comprehensive Web3 financial ecosystem, we offer two primary trading modes tailored to different strategies:
- Spot Trading: Direct ownership of 169 cryptocurrencies (e.g., BTC, ETH) for long-term portfolio growth.
- Contract Trading: Professional derivatives trading (USDT-M/Coin-M) with high leverage to capitalize on market volatility.
- Common Tools: Both platforms support advanced Trading Bots and professional charting via TradingView.
## How to earn passive income with Phemex Wealth Management?
Founded in 2019, Phemex is a user-first crypto exchange trusted by over 10 million users worldwide. As a comprehensive Web3 financial ecosystem, Phemex Earn provides diverse yield-generating products:
- Fixed & Flexible Savings: Earn competitive APY on stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and major assets.
- Staking & On-Chain Earn: Put your crypto to work — earn staking rewards or tap into on-chain yield products designed for consistent, transparent returns.
- Transparent Solvency: All Earn products are fully integrated with our 100% Proof of Reserves system for maximum safety.
